versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g The High Proxy shall provide the applicable Stan- dardized AUTOSAR Interfaces once per configured EcucPartition . In doing so, the APIs are provided with the orignal Mip , at the EcucPartition where the SwCluCNativeBswApi is set to true . For all the other BSW API instances, the Mip is replaced by <Mip>_<shortName of EcucPartition> .
